changelog.title: SteamLite 9.3.2 - Streak sync with your phone
items: Your play streak syncs with SteamLite Mobile right away
Streak restores and recovery are shown on the phone
Works with SteamLite Mobile 1.2.2
Message anyone on SteamLite Mobile to count as a play day and keep your streak
Works with SteamLite Mobile 1.2.1
Your banner, frame, title, accent, tagline and showcase are shared, so friends see them on PC and phone
Open a friend's profile to see their banner, title, tagline and showcase
Works with SteamLite Mobile 1.2.0
Let my phone launch games (off by default): the Play on my PC button in SteamLite Mobile starts a game on this PC
Send photos and GIFs in Messages: pick, paste or drop one into the chat
Record voice messages up to 60 seconds, with a player for your friends
Link previews, one-click quick replies and pinned chats
What should we play? finds the games everyone in a chat owns
Works with the new SteamLite Mobile app for Android, with a card in Messages to get it
Emoji picker, reactions, replies, edits, pins and search in Messages
Share a game with a Buy on Steam button, or share a whole game list
Profiles, online status with what friends are playing, and friend challenges
Connect your Steam library once: your API key is saved to your account, so new PCs connect on their own
A rebuilt Account page in Settings, with your profile, backup and data
Verified players get a blue tick, shown in chat, friends, themes and the leaderboard

news.title: SteamLite 9.3.2 Released - Streak sync
news.content: Your daily play streak now stays in step between your PC and SteamLite Mobile: launching a game updates the phone straight away, and a message sent from the phone counts as a play day on the PC.

news.title: SteamLite 9.3.1 Released - Keep your streak from your phone
news.content: Away from your PC? Sending a message in SteamLite Mobile now counts as a play day, so your streak keeps going. Pairs with SteamLite Mobile 1.2.1.

news.title: SteamLite 9.3.0 Released - Your profile look follows you
news.content: The look you give your profile (banner, avatar frame, title, accent colour, tagline and showcase) is now shared with your friends and with SteamLite Mobile. Open a friend's profile on the PC to see theirs too. Pairs with the big SteamLite Mobile 1.2.0 update.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.5 Released - Start games from your phone
news.content: A small update for SteamLite Mobile: turn on "Let my phone launch games" in Settings > More settings > Privacy and the Play on my PC button on a game page in the phone app starts that game on this computer.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.4 Released - Photos, voice messages and more
news.content: Messages now supports photos and GIFs (pick, paste or drop), voice messages, link previews, quick replies and pinned chats, and a What should we play? button that finds games everyone in the chat owns. It also works with the new SteamLite Mobile app, so friends on their phones can send and see the same things. Look out for the card in Messages that links to the app.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.3 Released - Account page, verified players and a richer Messages
news.content: Connect your Steam library once and every PC connects by itself, and Settings > Account is rebuilt. Messages got a big upgrade: an emoji picker, reactions, replies, edits, pins and search. You can share a game with a Buy on Steam button or a whole game list, see who is online and what they are playing, open profiles, and start friend challenges. Trusted players can carry a blue verified tick.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.2 Released - Themes rebuilt and chat polish
news.content: Themes have a brand new window with live previews of every theme, a Community tab to find and download themes other players made, and a My library tab for yours. The new Theme Maker has presets, a live preview and a Publish button that shares your theme with everyone. Chat also got a big polish: typing indicators with the three-dot bubble, animated sending and receiving, message grouping and a new-messages pill.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.1 Released - Messages, group chats and friend streaks
news.content: You can now message your friends inside SteamLite. Open Messages from the folder button in the header: add friends with a code or find your Steam friends who use SteamLite, chat privately or in group chats of up to 20, and keep a friend streak going by messaging each other every day. You can block and report anyone, and delete your own messages.

news.title: SteamLite 9.2.0 Released - Sign in with Steam
news.content: SteamLite now asks you to sign in with Steam when you open it. After one quick restart it loads your games and profile, backs up your progress to the cloud, restores it on any PC and gives verified players a tick on the leaderboard. Steam confirms who you are, SteamLite never sees your password, and it keeps working offline once you are signed in.

news.title: SteamLite 9.1.0 Released - Drops, Shop and more
news.content: The big one is here: Drops with streaks, rarities and a lucky wheel, a Shop and Trophy room, dashboard widgets, smart collections and tags, a weekly recap, a friend challenge, search everywhere, five new languages, accessibility options and restore points. Open the folder button in the header to find them.

news.title: SteamLite Day - Oct 7 to Oct 14
news.content: SteamLite Day is on until October 14. Complete 5 quests to earn the exclusive SteamLite profile title, the exclusive SteamLite avatar frame and the Remembering the Roots theme. Open the achievements window or the banner on your dashboard to see the quests. Update to SteamLite 9.0.3 to join.

news.title: SteamLite 10.0.0 comes January 2027
news.content: SteamLite 10.0.0 comes January 2027 with brand new features and [REDACTED]

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.2 Released - Settings fix
news.content: An emergency fix for 9.0.1: clicking a tab in Settings could push the top bar half off the screen. It is fixed in 9.0.2.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.1 Released - New achievements and themes
news.content: SteamLite 9.0.1 is out. A tidier header with the extras in one folder, a floating now-playing pill you can move anywhere, 15 new achievements, 3 new themes (Royal Gold, Mocha Cream, Sakura Night), icons instead of emojis and a redesigned news widget. A level now takes 80,000 XP; your current level is unchanged.

news.title: SteamLite 9.0.0 Released - Glass, Couch mode and more
news.content: SteamLite 9.0.0 is here. A new floating glass interface (Classic is one switch away), a full-page Settings, couch mode for your sofa with a page for every game, Spotify now playing in the top bar, a much better Discord presence card and a redesigned Tools & extras. It uses less memory and no idle CPU, and the Updater can now switch between Stable and Beta.
